units.source_text: 律师去后，老夫人唤小少将君过来，问她：

en.t: After the priest had gone, the elderly lady called Shosho no Kimi over and asked her:

units.source_text: “我听人说有这样的事，究竟怎么样？

en.t: I have heard people say that such a thing happened. What is the truth of it?

units.source_text: 为什么公主不把详细情形告诉我呢？

en.t: Why has the princess not told me the details?

units.source_text: 我不相信真有其事。”

en.t: I cannot believe it really happened.

units.source_text: 小少将觉得为难，但终于从头至尾详细告诉了她。

en.t: Shosho felt uneasy, but at last she told her everything in detail from beginning to end.

units.source_text: 又叙述今晨夕雾来信中的话以及公主隐约吐露的言语。

en.t: She also described what Yugiri had written in his letter that morning, and the words the princess had faintly let slip.

units.source_text: 末了又说：

en.t: At the end, she added:

units.source_text: “大将只不过把多年来隐藏在心中的意思向公主诉说而已。

en.t: The general merely told the princess of the feelings he had hidden in his heart for many years.

units.source_text: 他非常谨慎小心，天还没亮就回去了。

en.t: He was extremely cautious and careful, and went away before dawn.

units.source_text: 不知外人说些什么。”

en.t: I do not know what outsiders are saying.

units.source_text: 她万万想不到是律师说的，总以为是某一侍女偷偷地告诉老夫人的。

en.t: It never occurred to her that the priest had spoken of it; she assumed that one of the maids had secretly told the elderly lady.

units.source_text: 老夫人听了她的话，一言不发，只觉得伤心失意，泪如雨下。

en.t: When the elderly lady heard her account, she said nothing, but felt heartsick and desolate, and tears fell like rain.

units.source_text: 小少将君看了很难过，想道：

en.t: Seeing this, Shosho no Kimi was deeply distressed and thought:

units.source_text: “我为什么如实告诉了她？

en.t: Why did I tell her the truth so plainly?

units.source_text: 她正在患病，这样一来越发痛苦了。”

en.t: She is ill, and now this has only made her suffer even more.

units.source_text: 她很后悔，便又说道：

en.t: She regretted it deeply, and so she said further:

units.source_text: “他们会面是隔着纸隔扇的。”

en.t: They met with a paper screen between them.

units.source_text: 又说了许多安慰的话。

en.t: She then said many more words of comfort.

units.source_text: 老夫人说：

en.t: The elderly lady said:

units.source_text: “不管如何，如此疏忽大意，轻率地与男人会面，实在是不应该的。

en.t: Whatever the case, it was truly wrong to be so careless and to meet a man so rashly.

units.source_text: 即使实际上清清白白，但说那些话的法师，以及嘴尖的童仆，说话肯留余地么？

en.t: Even if she is in fact completely innocent, will the monk who said such things, and those sharp-tongued young servants, leave any room in what they say?

units.source_text: 教我们对人如何辩解？

en.t: How are we to explain ourselves to others?

units.source_text: 难道可以说明他们没有发生关系么？

en.t: Can we possibly prove that nothing happened between them?

units.source_text: 她身边的人都是不识轻重的……”

en.t: The people around her all fail to understand the gravity of things...

units.source_text: 没有说完，已经痛苦不堪。

en.t: Before she had finished speaking, she was already overwhelmed with pain.

units.source_text: 病中听到这种消息，自然是伤心的。

en.t: It was only natural that hearing such news while ill should grieve her.

units.source_text: 她满望公主做个气品高尚的皇女，如今结了世俗之缘，流传了轻薄之名，使她心中好生悲痛！

en.t: She had earnestly hoped the princess would remain a noble and dignified imperial daughter, but now she had formed a worldly bond and gained a reputation for frivolity, which filled her heart with bitter sorrow.
